title: CI/CD Pipeline Setup
description: Design automated deployment workflows. Tests DevOps fundamentals, multi-environment setups, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.

seo.overviewBody: CI/CD automation guarantees that code changes are built, tested, and deployed reliably. DevOps leads look for experience with GitHub Actions / GitLab CI workflows, matrix test runners, Docker container registry builds, environment secrets, and zero-downtime deployments.

deliverables.title: 1. GitHub Actions Workflow Configuration
deliverables.desc: Production-ready .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml file defining linting, unit testing, container build, and deployment jobs.

deliverables.title: 2. Container Build & Test Script
deliverables.desc: Automated container build script compiling production images and running isolated test suites in ephemeral containers.

deliverables.title: 3. Deployment Verification & Rollback Log
deliverables.desc: Audit log documenting automated pipeline execution, deployment health checks, and rollback triggers.

faqs.question: What is matrix testing in CI/CD pipelines?
faqs.answer: Matrix testing executes parallel pipeline jobs across multiple operating systems (Ubuntu, Windows) and language versions (Node 18, 20, 22) simultaneously.

faqs.question: How do you manage sensitive secrets in CI/CD pipelines?
faqs.answer: Secrets should be stored in encrypted repository settings (e.g. GitHub Secrets or HashiCorp Vault) and injected into runner environments at build time.

faqs.question: What is zero-downtime deployment?
faqs.answer: Zero-downtime deployment (like Blue-Green or Rolling deployments) routes traffic to new container versions only after health checks pass, preventing user disruption during updates.
